subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------CULT.SOLD.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-32 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's structural verdict on the sixties: 'these people were no more equipped to deal with the transition which took place in the sixties than their parents were … nothing had changed anyway.' MT-INFO (multi-information) is crossed with CULT-SOLD (culture solidification): the question is what multi-information produces when crossed with culture-solidification — the structural failure of the sixties being precisely that multi-information arrived but no culture-solidification followed. Above the main line, DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) branches from the subject and leads to SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) and on to FUND-P (fundamental particulars). Below it, VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branches from the subject and carries VT-PT, which leads to DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism), and AF-TD (affinity tendencies), which leads to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
